process.description: put 16 cups of warm water and a tablespoon of one step into a measure right 5 gallon jug that we used last time
Add one step no rinse cleansers to the jug - 1 tablespoon into 1 gallon of water
Added all the tools into the solution
Steralizing the 5 gallon tub with one step no rinse cleansers - start with rinsing and then add the cleanser and let sit for 10 minutes

Heat up Sugar and add to the jug - 3 cups of sugar one for each gallon - heat up small 1 to 2 in a pot and add the sugar and water and stir until the sugar is dissolve - we decided to dissolve it into two cups of water
Measured temperature of the jug of juice - 24 degrees C
Measured the Gravity of the liquid - with it hitting the bottom it is 1.058
Added the pectic enzyme to the jug - half of teaspon per gallon - 1/2 teaspoon per gallon - which in our case is 2 teaspoons - and we dissolved it in 1/4 cup of water
Wait 24 hours before adding the yeast

notesForNextTime: Use a large cylander to measure the gravity
Record the ambient temperature throughout the fermentation process
